articles.title: Trump Threatens Vetoes if Democrats Win
articles.description: President Donald Trump said he may have to become 'Mr. Veto' if Democrats win a majority in the midterms.

articles.title: TotalEnergies to Take Control of Upstream Projects for Malaysia LNG
articles.description: TotalEnergies agreed to acquire a 30 percent operating stake in the SK410B Lang Lebah and B14 gas fields off the coast of the Malaysian state of Sarawak.

articles.title: Oil Plunges as Iran Opens Door to Talks
articles.description: Brent crude reacted sharply in Monday trading as Iran signaled openness to renewed peace talks.

articles.title: Uniper, Lippstadt Utility Partner for Energy Storage Project
articles.description: Stadtwerke Lippstadt, a municipally owned utility of the German city of Lippstadt, executed a seven-year tolling agreement with Uniper for a 20 MW, 42 MWh battery energy storage project to be owned by Stadtwerke Lippstadt at the Rossfeld site.

articles.title: Kistos to Acquire 30 Percent in Abbey, Baker Gas Fields
articles.description: Kistos agreed to acquire a 30 percent stake in the Seaward Production Licenses containing the planned Abbey and Baker natural gas projects on the United Kingdom's side of the North Sea.

articles.title: Eni Starts Production at Maha Gas Field offshore Indonesia
articles.description: Eni and Petronas began production at the Maha field in Indonesia's Kutei Basin, a tieback project that grows the capacity of the Jangkrik Floating Production Unit by up to 250 million standard cubic feet per day of natural gas.

articles.title: TotalEnergies Now Sees Oil Demand Peaking Between 2035 and 2040
articles.description: A year after forecasting that oil demand would keep rising until 2040, TotalEnergies has moved its peak forward to between 2035 and 2040, and says the Iran war could accelerate the energy transition. The company’s annual energy outlook, released on Monday, projects demand for petroleum products plateauing through the 2030s before a slow decline. Chief sustainability officer Aurélien Hamelle told reporters that demand could fall faster if EV sales keep growing. In November 2025, TotalEnergies forecast oil demand rising nearly 5% to…

articles.title: Central Asia’s Power Grid Faces a Major Test as Winter Approaches
articles.description: Concern is rising in Central Asia about the region’s ability to generate sufficient heat and electricity during the upcoming winter season. Worries are perhaps greatest at present in Kyrgyzstan, where demand has surged in recent weeks due to the early onset of cold weather. An October 29 report published by the 24.kg news agency highlighted that Central Asia’s power grid is fragile, at risk of breaking down in winter. It cited a Eurasian Development Bank study of the grid’s performance in 2024 that showed it was frequently overloaded,…

articles.title: TotalEnergies strikes deal for Lang Lebah and B14 fields in Malaysia
articles.description: TotalEnergies has signed farm-out agreements to acquire a 30% operated interest in the Lang Lebah and B14 offshore gas fields.

articles.title: Oil Prices Plunge 7% as U.S. and Iran Signal Room for Diplomacy
articles.description: Oil prices plunged nearly 7% on Monday after Washington and Tehran both signaled they would give diplomacy a chance, wiping out part of the war premium that lifted crude through October. Brent traded at $105.60 per barrel, down $7.85, and WTI fell $7.20 to $96.92. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said on Monday that the Supreme Leader has granted the government “certain authorities” over peace talks and that Tehran “will try to resolve the problem with dialogue,” state media reported. articles.title: U.S.-Backed Consortium Proposes $4.4 Billion LNG Terminal in Pakistan
articles.description: A group of U.S. companies is proposing to build and operate a $4.4-billion LNG import and storage terminal in Pakistan, local media reported on Monday, as Pakistan faces high gas import costs with disrupted Qatari LNG flows. The companies, supported by the Trump Administration, include Global Vision Energy Partners (GVEP) and Khanjee Holdings, plus international strategic partners and Luxembourg-based General Mediterranean Holding, according to the reports. The integrated LNG project in Pakistan envisages imports, storage, re-gasification,…

articles.title: BP Completes $6B Sale of 65 Percent Stake in Castrol
articles.description: BP completed a deal to offload its Castrol lubricants business, giving the oil and gas major $6 billion to pay down debt as it works to repair the balance sheet.

articles.title: How Iran Just Broke the U.S. Oil Shield In Saudi Arabia Yet Again
articles.description: The attacks last week in Saudi Arabia’s largest oil refinery, Ras Tanura (again), by the Iran-backed Houthis (again), which pushed oil prices up (again), once more underlined the powerlessness of the region to properly defend itself from Iran and its network of proxies and the redundancy of the billions of dollars’ worth of defence equipment the region’s countries bought from the U.S. to do precisely this. articles.title: Eni begins gas production at Maha field offshore Indonesia
articles.description: Eni has commenced gas production from the Maha field, situated in the West Ganal block of the Kutei Basin offshore Indonesia.

articles.title: Chevron reports net income of $9.9bn in Q3 2026
articles.description: Chevron has reported net income of $9.92bn for the third quarter of 2026 (Q3 2026), a 180.4% increase from $3.54bn in the same period of 2025.

articles.title: Ukraine Has Hit Three Russian Refineries Since Friday
articles.description: A major oil hub in Russia’s Volga region appears to have caught fire after an attack, Bloomberg reported on Monday, citing satellite images from NASA’s Fire Information for Resource Management System. An image taken on Monday showed a relatively fresh heat anomaly, which could mean fires at the Samara crude oil pumping station, according to the imagery Bloomberg has analyzed. The potential attack, reports of which emerged in Ukrainian media today, could be another hit at an oil asset in Russia after Ukraine resumed late last week attacks…

articles.title: Resident AUVs are reshaping vessel demand
articles.description: Resident AUVs are reshaping support-vessel demand, providing more frequent inspections with fewer vessel days and lower costs and emissions.

articles.title: Brazil's Data Center Boom Faces a 14-GW Reality Check
articles.description: With the election settled, the presidency continuing for four more years and a newly elected Congress taking office in February, Brazil’s data center policy now hinges on execution, requiring tight coordination between parliament and the executive branch. Most clean tech policies can advance through decrees and agency rules, but data centers are an exception: Unlocking hyperscale investment requires Congress and the executive branch to align statutory tax incentive deadlines with regulatory definitions that are still to be written. articles.title: OPEC Keeps December Output Targets Unchanged
articles.description: Major OPEC+ nations reaffirmed plans to keep oil production quotas unchanged in December as conflict in the Middle East continues to curb swaths of the group's output.

articles.title: Oil Prices Plunge as Draft Proposal to End U.S.-Iran War is Circulated
articles.description: Oil prices extended losses from Asian trade into early Monday morning U.S. time as a draft proposal on a potential end to the U.S.-Iran war is now being circulated after Iranian negotiators left Qatar, an official briefed on the talks told Reuters on Monday. Oil prices slumped by 3% in Asian trade on Monday amid renewed optimism about a possible peace deal between the United States and Iran, following reports about mediation talks between Iran and Qatar over the weekend. Iranian negotiators left Qatar on Sunday and a draft proposal is now…

articles.title: ADNOC Chief Says World Has “Eroded Its Supply Buffers”
articles.description: The world needs strategic storage and refining capacity closer to consumers after 1 billion barrels of oil have been drained from global inventories following the disruption of Strait of Hormuz traffic, ADNOC’s chief executive Sultan Al Jaber said on Monday. The global energy system needs to be more resilient as the Middle East crisis has forced nearly 1 billion barrels of crude draws from inventories, Al Jaber said at the ADIPEC 2026 energy conference in Abu Dhabi. Diesel stocks in some markets have slumped to their lowest seasonal levels…

articles.title: Venture Global starts commercial operations at Plaquemines LNG
articles.description: Venture Global has begun commercial operations at Phase 1 of its Plaquemines LNG export project in Louisiana, US.

articles.title: Blackstone-Led Investors Buy into LNG Canada for $3.1 Billion
articles.description: Blackstone funds and Canadian institutional investors have teamed up to buy a stake in the LNG Canada export project for a total of $3.1 billion, the asset manager said on Monday. Funds managed by Blackstone Credit & Insurance, in partnership with leading Canadian institutional investors, have agreed to buy a 49.9% non-controlling stake in a unit of Mitsubishi Corporation that holds the Japanese firm’s 15% stake in LNG Canada. The Canadian institutional investors include Canada Pension Plan Investment Board (CPP Investments),…

articles.title: TotalEnergies to Acquire 30% Stake in Two Major Malaysian Gas Fields
articles.description: TotalEnergies has signed agreements to buy 30% operated interests in two offshore gas fields in Malaysia to boost supply to the existing Malaysia LNG plant, the French supermajor said on Monday. Under the agreements signed with PETRONAS Carigali Sdn Bhd (PCSB), a unit of Malaysia’s state energy firm Petronas, as well as PTTEP and KUFPEC, the French energy giant will buy a 30% operated interest in the Lang Lebah and B14 gas fields, located off the coast of Sarawak, Malaysia.
